name: Mega Al Sahar Cargo
headline: Cargo from Dubai to Saudi Arabia & GCC | Road Freight Services
lede: Fast, reliable door-to-door cargo services from Dubai to Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, & Kuwait.
about: Mega Al Sahar Cargo runs scheduled road freight between Dubai and the wider GCC — Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, and Kuwait — as our sole line of business, not a side service bolted onto air or sea freight.

Welcome to Mega Al Sahar Cargo, your trusted logistics partner for fast, secure, and affordable shipping from Dubai to GCC region, including Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, and Kuwait. With years of experience in freight forwarding, we handle everything from pickup to delivery — including customs clearance — ensuring a hassle-free shipping experience for our customers.
